```{r libraries}

}
```

# 1. Load embeddings files

```{r download-and-read}
embedding_paths <- c(
  "output/embeddings/user_embeddings_64.csv",
  "output/embeddings/user_embeddings_128.csv",
  "output/embeddings/user_embeddings_256.csv"
)

k_vals <- 2:20
all_results <- list()

```

# PD for all embedding sizes
```{r Silh}
for (embedding_path in embedding_paths) {
  
  cat("\nProcessing:", embedding_path, "\n")
  
  embeddings <- read_csv(embedding_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  
  user_ids <- embeddings[[1]]
  embedding_matrix <- embeddings[, -1]
  embedding_matrix <- scale(as.matrix(embedding_matrix))
  
  embedding_tag <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(embedding_path))
  dmat <- dist(embedding_matrix)
  
  results <- vector("list", length = max(k_vals))
  avg_silhouette <- rep(NA, max(k_vals))
  ch_scores <- rep(NA, max(k_vals))
  
  for (k in k_vals) {
    cache_file <- file.path(
      "output/pd_cache",
      paste0("pd_", embedding_tag, "_k", k, ".rds")
    )
    
    if (file.exists(cache_file)) {
      cat("Loading cached result for", embedding_tag, "k =", k, "\n")
      cached <- readRDS(cache_file)
      model <- cached$model
      labels <- cached$labels
      sil <- cached$silhouette
      avg_sil <- cached$avg_silhouette
      ch_val <- cached$ch
    } else {
      cat("Running PDC for", embedding_tag, "k =", k, "\n")
      
      model <- PDC(embedding_matrix, k = k)
      labels <- model$label
      sil <- silhouette(labels, dmat)
      avg_sil <- mean(sil[, 3])
      
      ch_val <- intCriteria(
        traj = embedding_matrix,
        part = as.integer(labels),
        crit = "Calinski_Harabasz"
      )$calinski_harabasz
      
      saveRDS(
        list(
          model = model,
          labels = labels,
          silhouette = sil,
          avg_silhouette = avg_sil,
          ch = ch_val,
          k = k,
          embedding_path = embedding_path
        ),
        cache_file
      )
    }
    
    avg_silhouette[k] <- avg_sil
    ch_scores[k] <- ch_val
    
    results[[k]] <- list(
      model = model,
      labels = labels,
      silhouette = sil,
      avg_silhouette = avg_sil,
      ch = ch_val
    )
  }
  
  pd_results <- data.frame(
    Method = "PD",
    k = k_vals,
    Silhouette = avg_silhouette[k_vals],
    CH = ch_scores[k_vals]
  )
  
  best_k <- k_vals[which.max(avg_silhouette[k_vals])]
  best_params <- pd_results[pd_results$k == best_k, ]
  
  best_model <- results[[best_k]]$model
  best_labels <- results[[best_k]]$labels
  best_sil <- results[[best_k]]$silhouette
  final_avg_sil <- results[[best_k]]$avg_silhouette
  
  cluster_df <- data.frame(
    UserID = user_ids,
    Cluster = best_labels
  )
  
  all_results[[embedding_tag]] <- list(
    embedding_path = embedding_path,
    embedding_tag = embedding_tag,
    embedding_matrix = embedding_matrix,
    user_ids = user_ids,
    pd_results = pd_results,
    results = results,
    best_k = best_k,
    best_params = best_params,
    best_model = best_model,
    best_labels = best_labels,
    best_sil = best_sil,
    final_avg_sil = final_avg_sil,
    cluster_df = cluster_df,
    dmat = dmat
  )
}
```


# 2a. Show Tuning Results
```{r Tuning}
for (name in names(all_results)) {
  cat("\n==========", name, "==========\n")
  print(all_results[[name]]$pd_results)
  cat("\nBest parameters:\n")
  print(all_results[[name]]$best_params)
}
```




# 2a. Plot Tuning Results
```{r Tuning-plot}

for (name in names(all_results)) {
  res <- all_results[[name]]
  
  p_sil <- ggplot(res$pd_results, aes(x = k, y = Silhouette)) +
    geom_line() +
    geom_point() +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title = paste("PD Model Selection by Silhouette -", name),
      x = "Number of Clusters (k)",
      y = "Average Silhouette Width"
    )
  
  print(p_sil)
  
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path("output/pd_plots", paste0("tuning_silhouette_", name, ".png")),
    plot = p_sil,
    width = 9,
    height = 6,
    dpi = 120
  )
}

for (name in names(all_results)) {
  res <- all_results[[name]]
  
  p_ch <- ggplot(res$pd_results, aes(x = k, y = CH)) +
    geom_line() +
    geom_point() +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title = paste("PD Model Selection by CH -", name),
      x = "Number of Clusters (k)",
      y = "Calinski-Harabasz Index"
    )
  
  print(p_ch)
  
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path("output/pd_plots", paste0("tuning_ch_", name, ".png")),
    plot = p_ch,
    width = 9,
    height = 6,
    dpi = 120
  )
}
```

# 3. Inspect best soln

```{r best-pd}
for (name in names(all_results)) {
  res <- all_results[[name]]
  
  png(
    filename = file.path(
      "output/pd_plots",
      paste0("silhouette_", name, "_k", res$best_k, ".png")
    ),
    width = 1200,
    height = 800,
    res = 120
  )
  
  plot(
    res$best_sil,
    main = paste("PD Silhouette Plot -", name, "(k =", res$best_k, ")"),
```

```{r sil-plots}
  )
  
  dev.off()
  
  plot(
    res$best_sil,
    main = paste("PD Silhouette Plot -", name, "(k =", res$best_k, ")"),
    col = "blue",
    border = NA
  )
}
```

# 4. Visualize with PCA


```{r pca-visual}
for (name in names(all_results)) {
  res <- all_results[[name]]
  
  pca <- prcomp(res$embedding_matrix)
  var_explained <- summary(pca)$importance[2, 1:2]
  
  pca_df <- data.frame(
    PC1 = pca$x[, 1],
    PC2 = pca$x[, 2],
    Cluster = as.factor(res$best_labels)
  )
  
  p_pca <- ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Cluster)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title = paste("PD Clusters (PCA Projection) -", name, "k =", res$best_k),
      x = paste0("PC1 (", round(100 * var_explained[1], 1), "%)"),
      y = paste0("PC2 (", round(100 * var_explained[2], 1), "%)")
    )
  
  print(p_pca)
  
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(
      "output/pd_plots",
      paste0("pca_", name, "_k", res$best_k, ".png")
    ),
    plot = p_pca,
    width = 9,
    height = 6,
    dpi = 120
  )
}
```


# Cluster sizes and probability silhouette
```{r size-sil}
for (name in names(all_results)) {
  res <- all_results[[name]]
  
  cat("\n==========", name, "==========\n")
  cat("Best k:", res$best_k, "\n")
  cat("Cluster sizes:\n")
  print(table(res$best_labels))
  cat("Probability-based silhouette:\n")
  print(Silh(res$best_model$probability))
}
```


# Save
```{r save}
# 9. SAVE RESULTS
for (name in names(all_results)) {
  res <- all_results[[name]]
  
  write.csv(
    res$cluster_df,
    file = file.path(
      "output",
      paste0("pd_clusters_", name, "_k", res$best_k, ".csv")
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  
  write.csv(
    res$pd_results,
    file = file.path(
      "output",
      paste0("pd_tuning_results_", name, ".csv")
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  
  saveRDS(
    res$best_model,
    file = file.path(
      "output/pd_cache",
      paste0("best_pd_", name, "_k", res$best_k, ".rds")
    )
  )
}

```
